newsitem.title: USA: Dow gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 50 points in mid-afternoon trading Thursday as the market pulled back buyers after sliding earlier on a second straight day of profit-taking.
At 2:19 p.m. EDT, the Dow index was up 52.25 points at 7,894.68, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
